_comment: Portable hook wiring for the Keel repo. Committed, so it must work on any
Two rules keep it that way:
1. Every command resolves via $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR (set by Claude Code for
all command hooks). Never write an absolute path here — `bstack
bootstrap` substitutes real paths by default, which is correct for a
private workspace and wrong for a public repo.
2. Every command points at a script vendored under this repo's scripts/.
Hooks whose implementation lives in a per-user skill install (role-x,
bstack's auth-preflight) are wired through a vendored shim that
delegates when the skill is present and exits 0 silently when it is
not — so a clone without those skills sees a no-op, never a broken
path. Anything genuinely machine-specific goes in
All hooks below are non-blocking (exit 0) except the P2 control gate, which
exits 2 to refuse a destructive action. Every script degrades gracefully
when its optional dependencies are absent.

hooks._purpose: Vendored shim — delegates to the role-x skill if installed, no-op otherwise
Warn (never block) if gh auth is missing, so an autonomous arc learns it at session start instead of dying on the push/PR step mid-task
